attribution.note: Zitron directly asserts the valuation and annual loss figures in his own commentary.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves his assertions. The financial statements are observations; the environmental and meaning judgments remain ungraded under the contract.

contract.note: Reading the annual burn figure as the widely reported 2024 loss is ordinary and fair in this context. The contract explicitly limits grading to the financial assertions.

evidence.note: OpenAI discloses the October 2024 funding round's $157 billion post-money valuation. This is a company disclosure.
Reports the company's projected 2024 loss of about $5 billion, which the contract accepts. It establishes the contemporary estimate, not the realised result.
Reports a 2024 net loss attributable to OpenAI of $5.09 billion. The article describes audited documents independently verified by the Financial Times.
Addresses first-half cash burn rather than full-year net loss. Its acknowledged unit error prevents reliance on the corrected amount without corroboration.

reviews.rationale: The packet supports the $157 billion valuation and reports a $5.09 billion net loss for 2024. The first-half cash-burn report concerns a different metric and period. Support applies only to the financial assertions, not the opinion clauses.
